sourceWitness.excerpt: 先是，王華既亡，曇首又卒，領軍將軍殷景仁以時賢零落，白太祖徴湛。

sourceWitness.excerpt: 曄妻先下撫其子，回罵曄曰：「君不為百歲阿家，不感天子恩遇，身死固不足塞罪，奈何枉殺子孫。」

decisions.independentReason: Source-supported: 阿家 is Ye's mother from Ye's perspective in this rebuke, not Ye's mother-in-law; the current English reverses the relationship. Verified independently against zh on s0321; applied idiomatic matches current chapter English.
decisions.before: Ye's wife came down first and comforted her child, then turned and cursed Ye: "You spare no thought for your aged mother-in-law, you show no gratitude for the emperor's grace and favor—your death alone could never atone for this crime, so why must you wrongfully destroy our children and descendants?"
decisions.after: Ye's wife came down first and comforted her child, then turned and cursed Ye: "You spare no thought for your hundred-year-old mother, you show no gratitude for the emperor's grace and favor—your death alone could never atone for this crime, so why must you wrongfully destroy our children and descendants?"

sourceWitness.excerpt: 妻云：「罪人，阿家莫念。」

decisions.independentReason: Source-supported: 罪人 refers to Ye, not to the wife herself; the current idiomatic English makes the wife call herself guilty. Verified independently against zh on s0325; applied idiomatic matches current chapter English.
decisions.before: His wife said: "I am the guilty one—mother-in-law, do not grieve over this."

sourceWitness.excerpt: 罪百浞、豷，過十玄、莽，開闢以來，未聞斯比。

decisions.independentReason: Source-supported: Chinese 過十玄、莽 names both Huan Xuan (玄) and Wang Mang (莽); the English omits 玄 and only has Wang Mang. Also 浞、豷 are Han Zhuo and Yi, not Zhou and Yan. Verified independently against zh on s0195; applied idiomatic matches current chapter English.
decisions.before: His crimes exceed those of Zhou and Yan a hundredfold, his excesses surpass those of Wang Mang tenfold—since the beginning of history, nothing like this has been heard.
decisions.after: His crimes exceed those of Han Zhuo and Yi a hundredfold, his excesses surpass those of Huan Xuan and Wang Mang tenfold—since the beginning of history, nothing like this has been heard.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 彭城王體自高祖，聖明在躬，德格天地，勳溢區宇，世路威夷，勿用南服，龍潛鳳棲，於茲六稔，蒼生饑德，億兆渴化，豈唯東征有《鴟鴞》之歌，陝西有勿翦之思哉！

decisions.independentReason: Source-supported: Recasts 世路威夷 as worldly vicissitudes and clarifies the classical Owl and protected-tree allusions. Verified independently against zh on s0199; applied literal matches current chapter English.
decisions.before: Prince of Pengcheng in body descends from Gaozu; sagely brightness is in his person, virtue reaches heaven and earth, merit overflows the realm; the age's road was awe-inspiring and level, yet he was not used in southern service—dragon hidden, phoenix perched, for six harvest-years here; the black-haired people hunger for virtue, the hundred millions thirst for transformation—is it only that the eastern campaign had the 'Owl' song, and west of the passes there was the thought of do not cut down!
decisions.after: Prince of Pengcheng descends in body from Gaozu; sagely brightness resides in him, his virtue reaches heaven and earth, and his merit overflows the realm. Through the dangers and ease of the worldly road he has gone unused in the southern lands, hidden like a dragon and roosting like a phoenix for six years. The people hunger for his virtue and the millions thirst for his transforming rule. Is it only the eastern campaign that had the song of the 'Owl,' or the lands west of the passes that cherished the thought of not cutting down the tree?
